headline: Khaitan & Co advises HarbourFront on RBI engagement on In-Specie distribution by a Category II AIF
sum: Khaitan & Co has advised HarbourFront India Investment Advisory LLP in connection with its engagement with the Reserve Bank of India regarding the proposed in-specie distribution of assets by a Category II AIF, registered with the…
detail: Khaitan & Co has advised HarbourFront India Investment Advisory LLP in connection with its engagement with the Reserve Bank of India regarding the proposed in-specie distribution of assets by a Category II AIF, registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India under the SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012, to a non-resident investor. The transaction team consisted of Divaspati Singh (Partner) and Rohan Priyadarshi (Principal Associate). Rahul Jain (Partner) provided assistance on direct tax aspects of the transaction. The mandate involved complex regulatory considerations and extensive engagement with the RBI over several rounds of discussions.
